notes: Restored Classical Latin: c and g are always velar; v is /w/; consonantal i/u are /j,w/; qu is /kw/; x is /ks/; Greek ch/ph/th retain aspiration; ae/oe/au are diphthongs. Macron and breve marks are honored. Unmarked vocalic nuclei use the predeclared conservative short-vowel assumption and are counted in quality output. Stress is not emitted because stress is not represented in the Enochian feature space.
